content:
matt: Heads-up: user upgraded to SDK v2 and hit two things: Vercel Edge crash `TypeError: require is not defined` and TS errors around overloads/generics.
sana: Likely ESM/CJS mismatch in examples. Do they set `type: "module"` but use `require()` somewhere?
matt: Exactly. Quickstart had a CJS snippet still. Edge environments are ESM-only, so `require` fails at runtime.
oliver: For runtime we should ensure we publish an ESM build and set package.json exports to include both import/require. Example: "exports": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}. Also call out explicit `import 'redwood-inference/esm'` usage for Edge.
kira: On the TS side the error was: `TS2769: No overload matches this call.` when calling `createClient()` with no args after upgrade. Our overloads force a model in one branch which breaks inference.
matt: We should add a single ergonomic signature to the public API: `function createClient<T = any>(opts?: ClientOptions & { model?: T }): Client<T>`. That keeps defaults friendly.
sana: Agree. For teams who want strict types we can provide `createStrictClient<T extends Model>(opts: ClientOptions & { model: T }): Client<T>`.
oliver: About `unknown` vs `any`: internal code should use `unknown` for safety, but exported types can provide ergonomic aliases: `export type SDKResponse<T = any> = InternalResponse<T>`. Also a helper `parseResponse<T = any>(r: SDKResponse<T>): T` to avoid casts in common flows.
kira: Runtime note: avoid top-level `process.env` reads and Buffer usage. Bundlers sometimes inline `process` and Edge breaks. Use guards: `const KEY = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env.KEY : (globalThis as any).__RW_KEY` and read lazily.
matt: Docs: add tsconfig snippet recommending `module: ESNext`, `moduleResolution: bundler`, `target: ES2020`. Also show package.json `type: module` for Edge examples.
sana: Add examples/edge-minimal that imports ESM entry and is tiny Next/Vercel-compatible. That will cut onboarding friction.
oliver: CI idea: run a small matrix of TS versions and a lint job that fails if `require(` appears in `examples/edge-*`. Catchs regressions early.
kira: Action items: 1) Add permissive no-arg overload + ergonomic generic default. 2) Export SDKResponse alias + parse helper. 3) Publish ESM dist and update exports. 4) Add edge-minimal example + docs snippet. 5) Add CI checks and lint for CJS in edge examples.
matt: I'll open a tracking issue and include a tiny repro. @devex-bot create issue "sdk: ESM/CJS parity + TS overload ergonomics"?
devex-bot: Created issue #3721: "sdk: ESM/CJS parity + TS overload ergonomics" and linked this thread.
sana: Great. I'll prepare the PR that modifies types and adds the example.
oliver: I'll follow up with docs updates for tsconfig and Edge gotchas.
matt: Thanks everyone — prefer small incremental PRs so we can patch quickly.
